## Checklist

- [ ] Follows the relevant ADRs, or adds a new ADR
- [ ] Threat model updated if this touches authorization, sandbox, egress, downloads or reports
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] Adds no feature excluded by the acceptable use policy
- [ ] New or updated tool pins include version, SHA-256 and the source of the checksum
